newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mixed as futures slip, swaps wave.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed as futures slip, swaps wave.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Thursday as crude futures slipped and swaps showed an unclear picture.
Heating oil barges lost up to $2 a tonne on weaker futures and easier premiums. Gas oil cargo premiums held.
Gasoline was steady with Eurograde summer spec barges trading around $216 fob ARA, but traders said further gains had been capped by losses in crude futures.
Naphtha softened amid healthy supply and poor local demand.

High and low sulphur fuel oil barge prices gained a little as swaps firmed. High sulphur barges traded at $92 fob ARA before slipping to $90, with further falls seen. Low sulphur barges were up at $94/$96 fob. Cargoes were quiet.
